title: WOLF
tagline: A whole year at the gym!
blurb: A whole year at the gym! Sweat it out in the summer heatwave, pull on a Christmas jumper for December, then face Stevo's end-of-year report card. Will you be Member of the Year? Pick up from any quarter with your password, or start a fresh year and do it all again.
controls: Beat; start a set, drink, ring the bell

demo.contains: Single-session demo: January's session with Stevo

credits.name: Mick Dunsby, Prue Fairley and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER

shots.caption: Dex hoists the bar, Stevo cheers below and every key you need is listed on the right.
